game.title: Gilli Danda
game.description: An ancient game considered a precursor to cricket and baseball, played with a small oval-shaped piece of wood (gilli) and a larger stick (danda) used to strike it.
howToPlay: Step 1: A small hole is dug in the ground or a circle drawn.
Step 2: Place the gilli across the hole with one end raised.
Step 3: Use the danda to flick the gilli into the air.
Step 4: Strike the airborne gilli with the danda to hit it far.
Step 5: Fielders try to catch the gilli before it lands.
Step 6: If caught, batter is out; if not, measure distance using danda lengths.
Step 7: Batter scores points equal to number of danda lengths.
Step 8: Players take turns batting and fielding.
Step 9: The player with highest total distance wins.
Step 10: Advanced players hit gilli multiple times before it lands.
